newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Japan backs EU plan for farm trade summit.
newsitem.headline: Japan backs EU plan for farm trade summit.

text.p: Japan has backed plans by European Union Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler to hold a meeting of the world's five main farm trading nations in Europe next March, a European Commission spokesman said.
The spokesman said that Japanese agriculture minister Takao Fujimoto expressed support for the idea during talks on Friday with Fischler.
The so-called Quint gathering would be linked to the annual meeting of OECD agricultural ministers in Paris and would involve the U.S., Canada, Japan, Australia and the EU.

The objective would be to discuss world agricultural issues rather than kick-start the next round of World Trade Organisation farm trade negotiations, which are not due to start until the end of 1999, the spokesman added.
EU sources said Washington had shown little enthusiasm for the meeting.
